nodes.label: Feature Separability Forest Plot
nodes.content: Forest plot (dot plot with 95% bootstrap CI): Feature Separability Natural→TTS Change across four viseme-level metrics. Intra-class Compactness: -0.005 [not sig]. Segment Stability: -0.005 [2/6 sig, highlighted red]. Boundary Sharpness: -0.005 [not sig]. Silhouette Score: -0.018 [not sig]. All metrics show small negative deltas (TTS slightly worse separability). Only Segment Stability shows marginal significance, suggesting TTS reduces segment consistency.
